request: Create a read-only code review workflow that checks correctness and test gaps with two parallel reviewers and returns a structured verdict.

lenses.purpose: Find correctness defects and missing test coverage before delivery.
lenses.object_model: Read repository files and return a structured review verdict without editing target files.
lenses.process_model: Explore the target, design two parallel review perspectives, review blockers, and return a handoff.
lenses.decision_model: Return BLOCKED when a correctness or validation blocker remains; otherwise return PASS.
lenses.evidence_model: Require repository evidence and explicit validation recommendations.
lenses.acceptance_model: PASS requires a structured handoff and no unresolved blocker.
lenses.boundary_model: Do not edit target files and do not perform managed apply.

success_criteria: The native meta-workflow is visible in /workflows and returns a structured PASS or BLOCKED result.
